_comment: 'When this attacks, if it is Draconic, deal 2 damage to any target.' Release-note timing honored: the trigger fires when the card becomes an attacking card (ON_ATTACK), and Draconic-ness is checked when the trigger RESOLVES — ability-level conditions run at resolution (interpreter.execute_ability), and CARD_IS_TALENT reads the card's live traits (classes/talents via _card_traits), so a Draconic talent granted after play still passes. GAP (flagged, not solved): 'any target' includes allies, and no generic-typed route reaches them. DEAL_ARCANE target:"ANY" is the only object-pool picker (_deal_arcane_to_objects offers both heroes plus allies) but it deals ARCANE damage — wrong type, wrongly interactable with Arcane Barrier/spellvoid. DEAL_GENERIC resolves its target ONLY through _damage_target_player, whose fallback for unrecognized strings is the CONTROLLER — authoring target:"ANY" here would deal 2 to MY OWN hero, so it must never be written. Drafted as target OPPONENT (the opposing hero): correct damage type and direction, under-inclusive because it can never name an ally. Second, smaller gap: the note has the target declared when the trigger is added to the stack; triggered-layer target declaration is an open engine item (docs/cr_audit_2026-07.md), so selection happens implicitly at resolution instead.
